metadata.description: Agent skills to deploy, run, extend, test and troubleshoot OLake.

plugins.name: olake-go
plugins.description: Run OLake end to end: deploy, connect sources and destinations, sync, verify and troubleshoot.

plugins.name: olake-ui
plugins.description: Run and use the OLake UI: set it up with docker compose, create sources, destinations and jobs in the UI or through the API, and manage them with GitOps.

plugins.name: olake-helm
plugins.description: Run OLake on Kubernetes with the olake Helm chart: install, configure, upgrade, read logs and uninstall.

plugins.name: olake-dev
plugins.description: For developers: build olake, olake-ui and olake-helm from chosen branches, deploy them together and test a feature or change end to end.
